name: WBML evidence status vocabulary

statuses.VERIFIED: A call/read completed successfully under the exact exported runtime sample and stated structural proof. Not a universal semantic guarantee.
statuses.OBSERVED: Seen at runtime or in exported evidence, but not promoted to a stronger guarantee.
statuses.OBSERVED-THREW: The exact exported invocation and argument set threw the recorded exception. It does not mean the method is universally broken.
statuses.VERIFIED-REVERSIBLE: A controlled mutation produced the expected scalar delta and the exact original value was restored with zero residual/collateral fields in the tested transaction.
statuses.VERIFIED-LIFECYCLE: The tested natural lifecycle path removed the entity from the pinned manager/owner/registry evidence sources and stale-reference checks passed.
statuses.VERIFIED-NONTERMINAL-WINDOW: The lifecycle call returned, but the same entity remained registered for the bounded exported observation window without game exceptions. No permanent-persistence claim.
statuses.VERIFIED-EMPTY-REGISTERED-WINDOW: All owned cities were removed, but the Kingdom stayed registered with zero cities for the bounded exported window without game exceptions. No permanent-persistence claim.
statuses.SKIP: Required branch/precondition was not executed. Never promote it to Verified.
statuses.FAILED-ASSUMPTION: A hypothesis/harness assumption was demonstrated to be wrong. Preserve as negative knowledge, not capability truth.
statuses.UNSAFE: Known or intentionally classified as unsafe to auto-invoke in the tested research policy.
statuses.UNKNOWN: The current baseline does not resolve the question.
statuses.research-needed: Documentation routing label: no current canonical evidence supports a stronger claim; create a focused WBML probe instead of guessing.

precedence_rule: Detailed docs + canonical machine export are source of truth. Quick docs summarize them and must preserve caveats.
